propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes resolved-status names ('Resolved', 'Done', 'Cancelled') in RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, while DC reconciler reads from config; tenants with non-standard workflow statuses cannot customize this without code changes
Issues with custom resolved-status names (e.g. 'Closed', 'Complete', 'Won\'t Do') are misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED due to hardcoded set
Cloud probe must read jira.resolved_statuses from config schema, defaulting to the current three names, with fallback behavior mirroring DC\'s ReconcilerConfig.resolved_statuses
Configured jira.resolved_statuses must be coerced via _as_str_list and support REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES environment override; empty or malformed config must fall back to module-level default

classify_probe_response must bind the configured resolved-status set at runtime; a custom tenant config setting resolved_statuses to a different list must produce PRESENT_RESOLVED classification only for issues in that configured set
